note: Personal names for invented people, one record per name, each with the passage where a real person bears it. The name is history; every invented person who carries it is invention. Many attestations are later or earlier than 405 to 395 BC; each record says when. Built with tools/name-finder.mjs from the saved texts of the phoenician-punic-world repo, then checked by hand. Card: docs/research/names.md.

siceliot.name: Sicilian Greeks
siceliot.detail: Names borne by Greeks of the Sicilian cities in the saved texts, from about 500 to 212 BC.

italiote.name: Italian Greeks
italiote.detail: Names of Greeks from the cities of southern Italy (Rhegium, Locri, Tarentum, Neapolis).

sikel.name: Sikels
sikel.detail: Names of Sikel leaders of the inland towns.

punic.name: Carthaginians
punic.detail: Names of Carthaginians, from 480 to 202 BC. The saved texts name almost no Carthaginian women.

libyan.name: Libyans
libyan.detail: Names of Libyans and Libyphoenicians who served Carthage.

campanian.name: Campanians
campanian.detail: Names of Campanians, mostly men of Capua in 216 to 211 BC, and two mercenary leaders.

iberian.name: Iberians
iberian.detail: Names of Spanish chiefs, 212 to 209 BC.

celt.name: Gauls
celt.detail: One name of a Gaulish mercenary leader.

greekAbroad.name: Peloponnesians
greekAbroad.detail: Names of Spartans and Corinthians who came to Sicily as commanders, envoys and hired men.
